notes: Platform-text detection for the `fortios` profile (tracker 271) is DOC_CLAIMED, not device-confirmed: the markers are the model/version line Fortinet documents for `get system status` ("Version: FortiGate-VM64-AZURE v8.0.0,buildXXXX,200330 (GA)") and the same tokens this document's vendor-level sysdescr_contains already carries. Deliberately NOT the bare vendor token "fortinet": FortiSwitch, FortiAP and FortiAnalyzer carry it and do not run the FortiOS command grammar. A FortiOS sysDescr is also operator-settable (`config system snmp sysinfo` -> description), so sysDescr alone is not a reliable identity here. Promote to live_capture when a real FortiGate reports.

snmp_configgen.v2c_template:
config system snmp sysinfo
    set status enable
end
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "<<community>>"
        set status enable
        set query-v2c-status enable
        config hosts
            edit 1
                set ip <<mgmt_subnet>> <<mask>>
            next
        end
    next
end
snmp_configgen.v3_template:
config system snmp user
    edit "<<sec_name>>"
        set status enable
        set queries enable
        set query-port 161
        set security-level auth-priv
        set auth-proto sha
        set auth-pwd <<auth_key>>
        set priv-proto aes
        set priv-pwd <<priv_key>>
    next
end
